quickAnswer.heading: Michelin-Inspired Gastronomy at Sea
paragraphs: Dining is an important part of the Crystal cruise experience. From Japanese-Peruvian cuisine created by Chef Nobu Matsuhisa to Italian fine dining, premium steaks, relaxed poolside meals and elegant multi-course dinners, Crystal offers a varied collection of restaurants and dining experiences.

On Crystal Serenity and Crystal Symphony, guests can choose from specialty restaurants, a traditional main dining room, casual eateries, cafés, gelato and 24-hour in-suite dining. Most restaurants are complimentary, while The Vintage Room carries an additional charge. Some premium menu items and additional specialty restaurant reservations may also cost extra.
This guide explores the restaurants, menus, reservation policies and dining costs to help you plan your Crystal voyage.

venueDetails.title: Crystal Cruises Restaurant Collection & Menus
intro: Crystal's culinary program features globally acclaimed chef partnerships alongside classic ocean liner dining traditions.
Below is a detailed guide to every venue aboard Crystal Serenity and Crystal Symphony, from Michelin-inspired fine dining to casual poolside comfort food.

items.title: 1. Umi Uma: Nobu-Inspired Japanese-Peruvian Dining
paragraphs: Umi Uma is one of Crystal's signature specialty restaurants and a highlight for guests who enjoy contemporary Japanese cuisine with Peruvian influences.

Created by celebrated master chef Nobuyuki (Nobu) Matsuhisa, the restaurant brings his distinctive culinary approach to sea. The menu combines traditional Japanese techniques, pristine seafood, bold Peruvian sauces, and meticulously balanced flavours.

Popular signature-style dishes include Nobu-style black cod marinated in sweet saikyo miso, grilled Chilean sea bass, and premium Wagyu beef preparations. An elegant sushi bar allows guests to watch master chefs prepare sashimi and nigiri fresh to order.

lists.title: Complimentary Reservation Allowances
items: Voyages up to 11 nights: One complimentary reservation included
Voyages of 12–22 nights: Two complimentary reservations included
Voyages of 23 nights or more: Three complimentary reservations included
Additional visits beyond allowance: $75 per person surcharge, subject to availability
Penthouse & Junior Penthouse Suites: Unlimited complimentary visits included

highlight.title: Angela's Insider Tip
highlight.text: For travellers who appreciate Japanese cuisine, sushi, and creative fusion dishes, Umi Uma is a specialty dining experience worth prioritizing. Reserve your table 180 days in advance via MyAccount as prime dining slots fill quickly.

items.title: 2. Osteria d’Ovidio: Italian Fine Dining
paragraphs: Osteria d’Ovidio brings an authentic, Michelin-pedigree Italian fine-dining experience to Crystal's ships. Named after Crystal owner Manfredi Lefebvre d’Ovidio, the restaurant was developed in close collaboration with the Michelin-rated Alajmo brothers, chefs Massimiliano and Raffaele Alajmo.
The restaurant focuses on regional northern Italian culinary heritage, refined artistic presentation, and carefully developed seasonal flavours in an intimate, elegant setting.

lists.title: What Makes Osteria d'Ovidio Special
items: Culinary collaboration with the renowned three-Michelin-starred Alajmo brothers
Refined regional pasta dishes, delicate risottos, and contemporary Italian mains
Complimentary reservation allowance: 1 to 3 visits based on voyage length
Additional visits beyond allowance: $75 per person surcharge, subject to availability
Unlimited complimentary visits for Penthouse and Junior Penthouse suite guests

highlight.title: Booking Recommendation
highlight.text: Particularly appealing to lovers of fine Italian gastronomy and romantic multi-course evenings. Book early on shorter sailings where the complimentary reservation allowance is limited.

items.title: 3. Beefbar: Contemporary Beef, Seafood & Plant-Based Dining
paragraphs: Created by visionary restaurateur Riccardo Giraudi, Beefbar brings a modern, stylish approach to luxury dining built around its signature Beef, Reef and Leaf concept.

The restaurant offers far more than a conventional steakhouse. Guests enjoy premium cuts of meat, fresh seafood, and inventive vegetarian or plant-based creations in an energetic, contemporary dining room.

lists.title: Beefbar Menu & Reservation Guidelines
items: Street-food-inspired appetizers, sharing plates, and signature bao buns
Prime Black Angus steaks, fresh fish, and delicate seafood selections
Artful vegetarian and plant-based 'Leaf' dishes for non-meat diners
Ultra-premium Kobe and Wagyu beef cuts available for an additional charge
Lunch: Walk-in casual dining with no reservations required
Dinner: Reservations required (one advance booking online, additional onboard)

highlight.title: Dining Atmosphere
highlight.text: Beefbar is fully complimentary for standard menu items. It is the perfect choice for guests wanting an upbeat, modern alternative to formal dining rooms, making it ideal for groups with diverse dietary tastes.

items.title: 4. Waterside: Crystal's Main Dining Room
paragraphs: Waterside is Crystal's grand main dining venue and the heart of the shipboard dining experience. Featuring panoramic ocean views and unhurried service, it serves open-seating dinner nightly with daily changing menus.
The culinary team crafts a balanced selection of classic favourites and contemporary regional specialties inspired by the ship's ports of call, prepared with fresh, seasonal ingredients.

lists.title: Waterside Highlights
items: Open-seating dining: dine whenever you wish during open hours with no reservations needed
Extensive daily changing menus offering appetizers, soups, mains, and desserts
Health-conscious, vegetarian, and low-sodium selections clearly indicated
Lunch service available on selected sea days and port afternoons
Fully complimentary as part of standard cruise fare

highlight.title: Convenience & Elegance
highlight.text: Waterside is the premier choice for guests who prefer traditional white-glove ocean liner dining and flexibility without being tied to pre-booked specialty reservations.

items.title: 5. Marketplace & Trident Grill: Casual Buffets & Poolside Comforts
paragraphs: For relaxed, daytime dining with indoor and outdoor alfresco seating, Marketplace and Trident Grill provide generous flexibility around shore excursions and pool time.

Marketplace offers an expansive global buffet for breakfast and lunch with live cooking stations, carving boards, artisanal cheeses, and fresh salad bars. Trident Grill serves made-to-order poolside comfort foods.

lists.title: Casual Venues Features
items: Marketplace: Made-to-order omelettes, fresh pastries, Asian specialties, and pasta stations
Trident Grill: Gourmet wagyu burgers, salmon burgers, wraps, hot dogs, and crispy fries
Alfresco teak-deck seating with sweeping ocean vistas
Covered resort wear permitted; swimsuits must have a cover-up and dry footwear
Both venues are completely complimentary throughout the cruise

highlight.title: Port Day Convenience
highlight.text: Marketplace is the easiest way to enjoy an energizing breakfast before an early morning excursion or a relaxed lunch after returning from a walking tour.

items.title: 6. The Bistro, Scoops Gelato Bar & The Vintage Room
paragraphs: Beyond its primary restaurants, Crystal features charming specialty venues for artisanal treats, European coffee culture, and ultra-exclusive cellar pairings.

The Bistro evokes a classic Parisian sidewalk café, serving specialty espresso drinks, fresh fruit, and sweet and savoury pastries throughout the day. Scoops Gelato Bar serves authentic Florence-crafted gelato by Badiani.
For serious wine collectors, The Vintage Room offers an intimate, sommelier-hosted multi-course feast featuring legendary vintage wines from the world's most prestigious vineyards.

lists.title: Key Venue Details
items: The Bistro: Complimentary gourmet coffees, herbal teas, cheeses, charcuterie, and pastries
Scoops Gelato Bar: Complimentary artisanal Badiani Italian gelato with rotating flavours and toppings
The Vintage Room: Private dining room seating 12-14 guests; multi-course wine pairing with Head Sommelier
The Vintage Room carries an additional charge; early reservations onboard or pre-cruise are recommended

highlight.title: The Vintage Room Experience
highlight.text: The Vintage Room is Crystal's premier chargeable culinary event. Solo travellers can request to join shared sommelier tastings, making it a wonderful social evening for wine lovers.

items.title: 7. 24-Hour In-Suite Dining & Penthouse Perks
paragraphs: Every stateroom and suite on Crystal Serenity and Crystal Symphony enjoys 24-hour complimentary in-suite dining served by private European-trained butlers.
Guests can dine at their suite's dining table or alfresco on their private veranda. Dishes are served course-by-course with crisp linens, fine china, and attentive personal hospitality.

lists.title: In-Suite Dining Advantages
items: Full hot breakfast served course-by-course on your private veranda
24-hour room service menu featuring soups, salads, burgers, and classic entrees
Dinner served from the daily Waterside menu during regular dining hours
Crystal Penthouse & Junior Crystal Penthouse perk: Order select dishes from Umi Uma and Osteria d'Ovidio to be served directly in your suite

highlight.title: Sanctuary Dining
highlight.text: Perfect for tired evenings after rigorous walking tours, early morning departures, or romantic veranda dinners watching the sunset over the wake.

bookingGuide.title: Crystal Specialty Dining Reservations: How to Book
bookingGuide.subtitle: STEP-BY-STEP RESERVATION PROCEDURE & CANCELLATION POLICIES

steps.title: 1. 180-Day Advance Window Opens
steps.description: Specialty dining reservations generally open 180 days before embarkation. Log in to your MyAccount on Crystal's official website as early as possible to access prime dinner hours.

steps.title: 2. Select Your Upcoming Voyage
steps.description: Within MyAccount, open your confirmed cruise reservation and navigate to the Dining & Onboard Activities section to view your available specialty venues.

steps.title: 3. Choose Venue, Date & Table Time
steps.description: Select Umi Uma, Osteria d'Ovidio, or Beefbar. Review available calendar dates and seating times that align with your port schedules and evening entertainment.

steps.title: 4. Confirm Pre-Cruise Allowance
steps.description: Crystal allows guests to pre-reserve one complimentary reservation at Umi Uma and one at Osteria d'Ovidio for up to two guests online before sailing.

steps.title: 5. Request Additional Dates Onboard
steps.description: Once aboard, speak with the Maître d' of Specialty Restaurants to book extra visits (subject to $75/person surcharge beyond allowance and table availability).

steps.title: 6. Flexible Booking & Cancellations
steps.description: Per Crystal's Food & Beverage FAQ, onboard dining reservations can be adjusted, rebooked, or cancelled at any time without penalty before the meal.

bentoHighlights.title: Reservation Allowances, Dietary Care & Dress Etiquette
bentoHighlights.subtitle: ESSENTIAL ONBOARD DINING POLICIES

cards.title: Complimentary Specialty Quotas
cards.description: Voyages up to 11 nights include 1 complimentary visit each to Umi Uma and Osteria d'Ovidio. Voyages of 12–22 nights include 2 visits each, and 23+ nights include 3 visits each. Extra visits cost $75 per person.

cards.title: Unlimited Specialty Dining
cards.description: Guests booked in Crystal Penthouse and Junior Crystal Penthouse Suites enjoy unlimited complimentary reservations at Umi Uma and Osteria d'Ovidio throughout the sailing.

cards.title: Allergies & Plant-Based Menus
cards.description: Crystal accommodates gluten-free, low-sodium, vegan, vegetarian, and severe food allergies. Inform Crystal before sailing and confirm with the dining staff on day one. Umi Uma also features delicious non-seafood creations.

cards.title: Evening Resort Attire
cards.description: After 6:30 p.m., specialty dining venues observe Evening Resort attire (collared shirts, jackets for men; elegant dresses, trousers for women). Formal attire is encouraged on designated Formal Evenings.

cards.title: Lunch vs. Dinner Policy
cards.description: Beefbar lunch requires no advance reservation—simply walk in. Dinner reservations are required and can be booked in advance online through MyAccount.

angelaAdvice.heading: Making the Most of Crystal Dining: Wisdom from 40+ Years at Sea
angelaAdvice.quote: Crystal's culinary program is among the finest at sea, especially with Chef Nobu Matsuhisa's Umi Uma and the Alajmo brothers' Osteria d'Ovidio. My top advice is to reserve your complimentary specialty slots as soon as the 180-day booking window opens, especially on voyages under 12 nights. Don't overlook Waterside—its daily changing menus rival top land-based restaurants, and enjoying a course-by-course dinner served by your butler on your suite veranda is one of luxury cruising's greatest pleasures.

faqs.question: How many restaurants are on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Crystal's dining collection includes specialty restaurants, a main dining room, casual restaurants, cafés, a gelato bar and 24-hour in-suite dining. The exact venue offering can vary by ship and sailing.

faqs.question: Is Umi Uma included on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Umi Uma is included within a complimentary reservation allowance based on voyage length. Additional reservations beyond the allowance may cost $75 per person, subject to availability. Crystal Penthouse and Junior Crystal Penthouse Suite guests receive unlimited complimentary visits under the current published benefits.

faqs.question: Is Umi Uma a Nobu restaurant?
faqs.answer: Yes. Umi Uma features Japanese-Peruvian fusion cuisine created by celebrated chef Nobuyuki (Nobu) Matsuhisa. It includes an elegant dining room and sushi bar.

faqs.question: Is Osteria d’Ovidio included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guests receive a complimentary reservation allowance based on voyage length. Additional reservations may incur a $75 per-person charge, subject to availability. Crystal Penthouse and Junior Crystal Penthouse Suite guests receive unlimited complimentary visits under the current published benefits.

faqs.question: Does Crystal Cruises have a steakhouse?
faqs.answer: Yes. Beefbar offers premium beef, seafood and plant-based dishes. The restaurant is complimentary, although selected premium Kobe and Wagyu meat cuts carry an additional charge.

faqs.question: Is The Vintage Room included on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: No. The Vintage Room is a private gourmet dining experience with vintage wine pairings and carries an additional charge. Confirm current pricing and availability onboard.

faqs.question: How far in advance can I book Crystal specialty restaurants?
faqs.answer: Crystal's current guidance states that specialty dining reservations can generally be made 180 days before embarkation, depending on the voyage and available offerings. Guests can book through MyAccount.

faqs.question: How much does an additional Umi Uma or Osteria d’Ovidio reservation cost?
faqs.answer: Crystal's current published Food & Beverage FAQ lists a charge of $75 per person for additional reservations beyond the complimentary allowance, subject to availability.

faqs.question: Can I eat at Beefbar without a reservation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lunch at Beefbar does not require a reservation under the current policy. Dinner reservations are required.

faqs.question: Does Crystal Cruises offer 24-hour room service?
faqs.answer: Yes. Crystal offers 24-hour in-suite dining with a selection of meals and snacks. Crystal Penthouse and Junior Crystal Penthouse Suite guests can also order selected dishes from Umi Uma and Osteria d’Ovidio, subject to service arrangements.

faqs.question: Can Crystal accommodate vegetarian or vegan guests?
faqs.answer: Crystal offers vegetarian and plant-based options, including at Beefbar. Guests should communicate dietary requirements before sailing and confirm menu details with the onboard dining team.

faqs.question: Are dining hours the same every day?
faqs.answer: No. Dining hours can change according to daily activities, itinerary, time zone and availability. Crystal publishes daily operating information in its onboard Reflections newsletter.
